subject: Brownfield SWE.3 checklist version v0.4-brownfield (proposal specs/008-brownfield-work-orders/proposals/checklist-v0.4-brownfield.md, research R8, task BF-T019)
decision: Items 1-3 of the proposal accepted as written. factory/checklists/v0.4-brownfield/SWE.3.yaml adds SWE3-07..09 decided on the delivered code (declared guideline or recorded findings; register definitions the delivered code uses, CMSIS via static-assertion probes; allocated functions present and fingerprints unchanged or changed by a linked fix) and keeps SWE3-10. It extends the same hash-pinned v0.3 base. The engine selects it only for manifests with a delivery block; greenfield keeps v0.4 unchanged.
follow_up: The factory change (engine selection, delivered-code checks) goes through the CRE promotion gate. The proposal's further ST-pilot items (host device shim, Renode 8 KB RCC window and set/clear registers, Robot CMSIS tokens) are factory changes, not part of this decision.
not_changed: factory/checklists/v0.4 and the v0.3 base are unchanged; no compliance, certification or safety approval.
